answer: Spectral gap admission. Track each agent's neighbor-set overlap across epochs; admit only nodes whose overlap sits inside the current population's median band, so a newly minted cluster stands out as an isolated nebula of near-identical links. Enforcement: agents below the band get throttled routing until their edges diversify toward the zenith of observed overlap. Attacker cost: each fake identity must sustain organic, non-repeating connections to distinct honest nodes for several epochs, and any whisper of coordinated linking collapses the whole cluster's gap score at once.
